What is opencl-nvidia-580xx?

This package provides the OpenCL implementation shipped with NVIDIA's 580xx proprietary driver series, so NVIDIA GPUs can be used for general-purpose parallel compute through the standard OpenCL API (alongside CUDA). It's a low-level driver component rather than an application — it does nothing on its own and is installed to pair with the matching nvidia-580xx driver package.

Install opencl-nvidia-580xx on Omarchy

official Omarchy package command
$ omarchy pkg add opencl-nvidia-580xx

Good to know

  • An NVIDIA GPU supported by the 580xx driver branch
  • The matching nvidia-580xx driver package installed
